# Sofara

> Sofara is a Dubai and UAE real estate ambassador platform for people who refer qualified property buyers and earn commission in AED.

Sofara connects ambassadors with Dubai real estate opportunities operated with Cevitas Real Estate LLC. The platform focuses on Dubai off-plan property, referral commissions, investor education, and ambassador training.

## Pages

- [Sofara homepage](/): Dubai real estate ambassador platform overview.
- [Ambassador Program](/ambassador-program): How the Sofara ambassador model works.

- [Buy Property in Dubai](/buy-property-dubai): Step-by-step guide for foreign buyers.
- [Dubai Off-Plan Properties](/dubai-off-plan-properties): Off-plan property investment guide.
- [Sofara Blog](/blog): Dubai real estate, ambassador and market guides.
